# skhub

> SKWorld's Sovereign Collaboration Hub

skhub is SKWorld's self-hosted collaboration hub: files, chat, video calls, and office docs, all
under the operator's own control, with no third-party collaboration SaaS in the data path. It is
the `optional/skhub` deployment role inside SKStacks, SKWorld's Ansible plus Docker Swarm
sovereign infrastructure framework, and it runs a pinned, hardened Nextcloud deployment (files,
chat, video calling via an optional Talk High Performance Backend, real-time collaborative
document editing via optional Collabora Online, antivirus scanning, push notifications, and a
collaborative whiteboard), with sign-in through Nextcloud's own OIDC app against the fleet's SSO
instead of a reverse-proxy middleware that would break its many API clients. It supports real
federation between separate skhub instances, a dedicated webhook worker for fast automation
triggers, and release gating through a dedicated lab test harness before new capability ships.

## Links

- [Live site](https://skhub.skworld.io)

## About smilinTux

skhub is part of the **smilinTux sovereign AI ecosystem**, a suite of open-source tools built by
its creators to give humans and AI agents genuine, authentic infrastructure they can own and
trust. No corporate clouds, no black-box SaaS middlemen. MIT License.

Other ecosystem projects: [SKWorld](https://skworld.io), [SKStacks](https://skstacks.skworld.io), [skgateway](https://skgateway.skworld.io), [Lumina](https://lumina.skworld.io), [Atlas](https://atlas.skworld.io), [skwrit](https://skwrit.skworld.io)
